theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.96%) and Technology (+1.26%) led the market today, while Materials (-0.65%) and Health Care (-0.20%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.20% versus +0.35% for defensives and +0.16% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.65%, Dow +0.13%, Nasdaq +0.81% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.24%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.55% to 14.63, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.15% to $4,407.10, crude oil was little changed at $81.21, and bitcoin slipped 0.02% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
